title: SmartGN - IAM
description: Identity, account activation and recovery, current sessions, profiles and delegated access by meter and function. Owns an independent PostgreSQL database and integrates through authenticated HTTP and durable events. Local fixtures do not establish productive external integration.

tags.Authentication: Sign-in, activation, password recovery and current-session management.
tags.Delegated access: Principal-owned delegated USER accounts and independent per-meter function grants.
tags.Internal identity: Private identity, session and authorization contracts.

operations.summary: Sign in to an active account
operations.description: Validates credentials and returns a current IAM JWT. Inactive accounts and invalid credentials are rejected. Authentication: no user JWT required; the operation-specific token or checkout secret still applies when specified.

Consumes a single-use activation token and activates the pending principal or delegated account. Authentication: no user JWT required; the operation-specific token or checkout secret still applies when specified.

Returns the same accepted response for known and unknown email addresses. Eligible accounts receive a recovery message through the configured delivery adapter. Authentication: no user JWT required; the operation-specific token or checkout secret still applies when specified.

Consumes a recovery-purpose token once and invalidates existing sessions. Activation tokens cannot be used for recovery. Authentication: no user JWT required; the operation-specific token or checkout secret still applies when specified.
Requires the current password and authenticated account. Invalidates previously issued sessions after a successful change. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Creates a profile only when the authenticated account has none. Duplicate profiles are rejected. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Returns only the profile associated with the authenticated account. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Updates the authenticated account's editable profile fields. Account identity and role cannot be changed here. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Allows the profile owner or SUPERADMIN to read the requested profile. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Allows only the profile owner to update editable fields. SUPERADMIN does not acquire ownership by role alone. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires a principal USER and returns only its delegated accounts. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires a principal USER. Creates a pending USER account without initial meter grants or financial permissions. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires the owning principal USER and verified meter ownership. Replaces grants for this meter while preserving other meters. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires the owning principal USER. Returns the delegated account's current permissions on the requested meter. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.
Requires the owning principal USER. Revokes this meter's grants while preserving other meters and audit history. Authentication: current IAM JWT; roles are USER and SUPERADMIN.

Provisions a pending principal from trusted purchase evidence. Repeated receipts are idempotent; contradictory identities are rejected. Authentication: private service credential; user JWTs are not accepted. Internal routes must remain outside public gateway routing.

Verifies JWT cryptography, issuer, audience, expiry, account status and session version. Returns account context without credentials. Authentication: private service credential; user JWTs are not accepted. Internal routes must remain outside public gateway routing.

operations.summary: Check a meter and function authorization
operations.description: Checks current ownership and delegated grants. When requiresPro is true, confirms the principal's entitlement with Billing. Authentication: private service credential; user JWTs are not accepted. Internal routes must remain outside public gateway routing.

Returns current role, account kind, status and principal reference to trusted consuming services. Authentication: private service credential; user JWTs are not accepted. Internal routes must remain outside public gateway routing.

Returns the current delegated meter/function snapshot. Credentials and one-time secrets are never included. Authentication: private service credential; user JWTs are not accepted. Internal routes must remain outside public gateway routing.
